import math
import sys

def main():
    mod = 998244353
    input = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    n = int(input[0])
    k = int(input[1])
    v = [0] * 10
    index = 2
    for _ in range(k):
        x = int(input[index])
        index += 1
        v[x] = 1
    ans = [1]
    p = n // 2
    while True:
        if p % 2 != 0:
            ans = multiply_mod(ans, v, mod)
        p //= 2
        if p == 0:
            break
        v = multiply_mod(v, v, mod)
    res = 0
    for x in ans:
        res = (res + x * x) % mod
    print(res)

def multiply_mod(a, b, mod):
    need = len(a) + len(b) - 1
    n = max(2, 1 << (need - 1).bit_length())
    a_real = [0.0] * n
    a_imag = [0.0] * n
    for i in range(len(a)):
        x = (a[i] % mod + mod) % mod
        a_real[i] = x & ((1 << 15) - 1)
        a_imag[i] = x >> 15
    fft(a_real, a_imag, False)
    b_real = [0.0] * n
    b_imag = [0.0] * n
    for i in range(len(b)):
        x = (b[i] % mod + mod) % mod
        b_real[i] = x & ((1 << 15) - 1)
        b_imag[i] = x >> 15
    fft(b_real, b_imag, False)
    fa_real = [0.0] * n
    fa_imag = [0.0] * n
    fb_real = [0.0] * n
    fb_imag = [0.0] * n
    for i in range(n):
        j = (n - i) & (n - 1)
        a1r = (a_real[i] + a_real[j]) / 2
        a1i = (a_imag[i] - a_imag[j]) / 2
        a2r = (a_imag[i] + a_imag[j]) / 2
        a2i = (a_real[j] - a_real[i]) / 2
        b1r = (b_real[i] + b_real[j]) / 2
        b1i = (b_imag[i] - b_imag[j]) / 2
        b2r = (b_imag[i] + b_imag[j]) / 2
        b2i = (b_real[j] - b_real[i]) / 2
        fa_real[i] = a1r * b1r - a1i * b1i - a2r * b2i - a2i * b2r
        fa_imag[i] = a1r * b1i + a1i * b1r + a2r * b2r - a2i * b2i
        fb_real[i] = a1r * b2r - a1i * b2i + a2r * b1r - a2i * b1i
        fb_imag[i] = a1r * b2i + a1i * b2r + a2r * b1i + a2i * b1r
    fft(fa_real, fa_imag, True)
    fft(fb_real, fb_imag, True)
    res = [0] * need
    for i in range(need):
        aa = int(round(fa_real[i]))
        bb = int(round(fb_real[i]))
        cc = int(round(fa_imag[i]))
        res[i] = (aa + ((bb % mod) << 15) + ((cc % mod) << 30)) % mod
    return res

def fft(a, b, inverse):
    n = len(a)
    shift = 32 - (n.bit_length() - 1)
    for i in range(1, n):
        j = int('{:b}'.format(i << shift)[::-1], 2)
        if i < j:
            a[i], a[j] = a[j], a[i]
            b[i], b[j] = b[j], b[i]
    len_ = 2
    while len_ <= n:
        half = len_ // 2
        angle = 2 * math.pi / len_ * (-1 if inverse else 1)
        wlen_cos = math.cos(angle)
        wlen_sin = math.sin(angle)
        for i in range(0, n, len_):
            w_cos = 1.0
            w_sin = 0.0
            for j in range(half):
                u_a = a[i + j]
                u_b = b[i + j]
                v_a = a[i + j + half] * w_cos - b[i + j + half] * w_sin
                v_b = a[i + j + half] * w_sin + b[i + j + half] * w_cos
                a[i + j] = u_a + v_a
                b[i + j] = u_b + v_b
                a[i + j + half] = u_a - v_a
                b[i + j + half] = u_b - v_b
                temp_w_cos = w_cos * wlen_cos - w_sin * wlen_sin
                w_sin = w_cos * wlen_sin + w_sin * wlen_cos
                w_cos = temp_w_cos
        len_ <<= 1
    if inverse:
        for i in range(n):
            a[i] /= n
            b[i] /= n

    main()
